text: The team used an amber lantern beside the northern entrance.
The silver compass was finally recovered from the archive.
A second amber lantern appeared in the inventory.
Amber lantern: brass case, blue handle.
The silver compass shares a display case with a broken watch.
There was an amber lantern but no other remembered object.
A silver compass alone cannot establish the connection.
